rs.innovation_approach: 在学生自己的纯文本想象轨迹上，用冻结同初始化教师提供逐token分布；教师额外看GT区域裁图与答案，学生只看原图问题，通过reverse KL转移特权视觉上下文。
rs.key_step: 对同一学生前缀y<t比较q_t=πθ(I,Q,y<t)与p_t=πθ̄(I,Q,crops,A,y<t)，最小化平均KL(q_t||p_t)；θ̄固定，学生不断重采自身轨迹。
rs.why_non_obvious: 无需更大外部教师或预先正确的想象示范；相同初始模型通过更丰富输入生成教学分布。但同初始化并不等于当前策略，GT答案与区域标注是实质监督，不能称无标注。
rs.trigger_condition: When reliable annotated local evidence is available during training but deployment should avoid crop tools, distill a frozen privileged-input teacher on the student’s own textual reasoning prefixes.
reviewer_praise: low_evidence: no reviews_path or independent review artifact supplied.
reviewer_concern: low_evidence: reviewer concerns unavailable; reader observations are separated below.
rs.acceptance_signal: low_evidence; manifest decision=null copied without inferring acceptance.
rs.abstract_strategy: Move privileged observations into training and teach an inexpensive deployment path on its own generated prefixes.
rs.abstract_key_step: Hold a teacher fixed, enrich its context with annotated evidence and an answer, then match its next-step distribution at each student-generated prefix.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: A teacher can gain instructional power from information rather than larger parameters, but its privileged outputs are not proof the student possesses the same observable evidence.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When rich evidence exists for training and external operations are costly at deployment, transfer conditional distributions into a path that uses only the original input.

limitations.text: Only zoom-based intermediateviews fromannotatedevidence tested; broader manipulations may needother supervision.
limitations.quote:
Our current study focuses on zooming-based intermediate views derived from annotated evidence
regions. This keeps the supervision signal clear
and stable, but also limits the scope of the current conclusions. More diverse and complex image
manipulations may require different supervision
mechanisms and may not transfer equally well into
Thinking with Imagination.

limitations.text: Training requires region annotations; weaker/noisier supervision remains future work despite selfbox ablation.
limitations.quote:
In addition, our current
experiments require region annotations available
during training, extending the framework to weaker
or noisier region supervision is an important direction for future work.

engineering.lesson: 当用特权输入做自蒸馏时，应把“相同初始化”与“实时共享策略”分开：本篇固定教师有效而在线教师报告归零；先钉住教师、显式记录GT答案/区域与学生可见像素，并用信息消融排除仅靠答案提示的解释。

relevance.how: 逐tokenKL不依赖组内结果差，理论上能为错轨迹给非零信号；但本文只训练base≥2/4正确的题，没有全错难题验证，不能声称解决P07。
教师crop+答案与学生全图的特权差正对应可读性错配；实验证明平均收益，不证明缩放后不可辨细节被恢复。需学生视图可读性审计。
可对学生自己caption式轨迹提供dense evidence-conditioned target，但答案条件化教师和文本格式不等于事实金标。
针对想象文本每token训练，邻近caption监督；无事实率/忠实性评测，不能直接升级caption质量保证。
完整方法依赖GTboxes，selfboxarm更弱且prompt强制猜框，不适用多数无框题的直接照搬。
去除推理crop降低外部视觉编码开销，但额外训练teacher/crop成本未计清；不等价于既有多轮分叉降成本。

information_boundary.teacher: Initial frozen same-base checkpoint; observes original image, question, all annotated evidence crops, GT answer and student prefix. Appendix B explicitly includes Ground truth {answer}.
information_boundary.student: Original image, question and prior generated tokens only; no GT answer, boxes, crop images or tools at inference. Training uses GT indirectly through the teacher distribution.
information_boundary.future_information: The formal teacher conditional ends at y<t and does not expose future student tokens. However, oracle answer and all GT regions are privileged task-solution information available from the start.
information_boundary.prompt_boundary: Teacher must hide additional images and describe crop operations as mental manipulations. Such wording does not demonstrate that the student observed new pixels. Self-box proposal sees I,Q without GT answer but must always guess one box, even when uncertain.
information_boundary.judge: GRPO control uses rule-based answer matching. The teacher provides distributions, not binary factuality labels. Evaluation judge details are unspecified. Data filtering uses four Qwen3-VL-4B responses; exact correctness matching is not stated.
